name: Kokoro-82M (instant)
blurb: Apache-2.0, 82M params — faster than real time, excellent built-in voices. NO cloning: this is the instant engine for notifications, say.cmd and quick reads.

params.label: Built-in voice
params.help: e.g. af_heart, af_bella, af_nicole, am_michael, am_fenrir, bf_emma, bm_george. Full list: hf.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M/tree/main/voices

params.label: Speaking rate (generation)
params.help: Kokoro's own rate control — needs a regenerate. Use the live Speed slider below for instant tweaks.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift the voice up/down, keeping timbre (TD-PSOLA).

params.label: Intonation range
params.help: How far the pitch swings around its median: 0 = monotone, 1 = as generated, 1.5+ = extra expressive.

params.label: Speed
params.help: Playback tempo without changing pitch (TD-PSOLA), on top of the generation rate.
